title: Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir, Al-Batin: The Four Divine Names That Appear in One Verse and Nowhere Else
excerpt: Four of the ninety-nine names sit in a single sentence at 57:3, and none of them names God anywhere else in the Quran. Ibn Kathir counts more than ten different explanations of it.
seo_title: Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir, Al-Batin: The Four Names of Quran 57:3
seo_description: Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir and Al-Batin appear together at Quran 57:3 and nowhere else. How al-Jalalayn, al-Muyassar and Ibn Kathir read the four names.
